stages.reference: Create a close visual reference for a large mass of old worked iron or steel in a grounded dark-fantasy industrial world. The metal should feel forged and repeatedly handled: dense gray body metal, subtle hammer-scale variation, fine scratches, shallow dents, dark oxide in recesses and restrained brown oxidation where moisture lingered. Keep broad areas metallic and solid rather than uniformly rusty. Avoid stainless-steel polish, brushed modern appliance texture, chrome reflections, diamond plate or orange rust covering everything. Establish practical heavy ferrous metal shaped by forge heat, tools and years of exposure.
